issues.on_page: Crossed-out Exhibit A versions (pp2, 4): total receipts 111,235.05, disbursements 93,585.78, ending 330,956.19
issues.issue: The void crossed-out pages are mentioned only in notes. There is no report_discrepancies entry recording the differing figures, as the crossed-out page rule asks for. The figures used (unmarked pp1, 3) are correct.
The amount 149,585.77 is correct as cash only, but the computed note also lists the investment parts, which belong to assets[2]. The note is misleading.

The printed county treasurer balance is not recorded and not mentioned in notes. It is outside the form's line 28 total, but CLAUDE.md treats county treasurer balances as Cash and Cash Equivalents. A person should confirm whether to leave it out.
